scope: App-side ProductAnalytics events only; RevenueCat provider events require a separate live inventory.

events.description: The app initialized its analytics service during launch. A launch is not a new install or a login.
events.meaning: The app initialized its analytics service during launch.
events.interpretation: A launch is not a new install or a login.

events.description: An instrumented authentication operation ended without success. Use provider and auth_operation; do not infer the person's reason.
events.meaning: An instrumented authentication operation ended without success.
events.interpretation: Use provider and auth_operation; do not infer the person's reason.

events.description: An instrumented Apple, Google, or email authentication operation began. Use provider and auth_operation; anonymous launch is not counted as a login here.
events.meaning: An instrumented Apple, Google, or email authentication operation began.
events.interpretation: Use provider and auth_operation; anonymous launch is not counted as a login here.

events.description: An instrumented authentication operation completed successfully. Can mean account linking or account creation, not just sign-in.
events.meaning: An instrumented authentication operation completed successfully.
events.interpretation: Can mean account linking or account creation, not just sign-in.

events.description: The client's full-book kickoff task was cancelled. Can result from replacement or task cancellation, not necessarily a deliberate user cancel.
events.meaning: The client's full-book kickoff task was cancelled.
events.interpretation: Can result from replacement or task cancellation, not necessarily a deliberate user cancel.

events.description: The client finished or restored the book-ready finalization state. May repeat on resume; count unique people, not unique books, without a stable job identifier.
events.meaning: The client finished or restored the book-ready finalization state.
events.interpretation: May repeat on resume; count unique people, not unique books, without a stable job identifier.

events.description: The client observed full-book failure at kickoff, cloud job, or finalization. Use failure_stage; repeated snapshots may repeat observations.
events.meaning: The client observed full-book failure at kickoff, cloud job, or finalization.
events.interpretation: Use failure_stage; repeated snapshots may repeat observations.

events.description: The client requested a full-book generation run with a target page count. Not authoritative backend acceptance; page_count is requested target here.
events.meaning: The client requested a full-book generation run with a target page count.
events.interpretation: Not authoritative backend acceptance; page_count is requested target here.

events.description: The client observed the cloud illustration-completion milestone. Client finalization still remains; memory_count is completed illustrated memories.
events.meaning: The client observed the cloud illustration-completion milestone.
events.interpretation: Client finalization still remains; memory_count is completed illustrated memories.

events.description: The installation recorded its first launch using local defaults. Can repeat after reinstall or on another device; not first-ever customer.
events.meaning: The installation recorded its first launch using local defaults.
events.interpretation: Can repeat after reinstall or on another device; not first-ever customer.

events.description: A tracked field edit ended with character_count and duration_ms. Count and duration only; no field contents. Abandoned edits may lack completion.
events.meaning: A tracked field edit ended with character_count and duration_ms.
events.interpretation: Count and duration only; no field contents. Abandoned edits may lack completion.

events.description: The first edit began for a named field in the current input session. No typed text or individual keystrokes are collected.
events.meaning: The first edit began for a named field in the current input session.
events.interpretation: No typed text or individual keystrokes are collected.

events.description: Extracted character details were successfully encoded and saved to the local memory store. Local persistence only; cloud synchronization is queued afterward. Historical builds before this fix could report attempted saves as success.
events.meaning: Extracted character details were successfully encoded and saved to the local memory store.
events.interpretation: Local persistence only; cloud synchronization is queued afterward. Historical builds before this fix could report attempted saves as success.

events.description: The guided memory-enhancement screen appeared. voice_available indicates whether voice interaction is available.
events.meaning: The guided memory-enhancement screen appeared.
events.interpretation: voice_available indicates whether voice interaction is available.

events.description: Guided extraction completed and produced character details. characters_extracted counts people/characters, not letters; not a save guarantee.
events.meaning: Guided extraction completed and produced character details.
events.interpretation: characters_extracted counts people/characters, not letters; not a save guarantee.

events.meaning: Guided enhancement could not encode or locally persist the extracted character details.
events.interpretation: No successful-save event is sent for this attempt. Final saves offer retry; partial saves report an error and remain eligible for another attempt.
events.description: Guided enhancement could not encode or locally persist the extracted character details. No successful-save event is sent for this attempt. Final saves offer retry; partial saves report an error and remain eligible for another attempt.
A memory audio player reported playback completion. Use playback_source to distinguish local and remote.
events.meaning: A memory audio player reported playback completion.
events.interpretation: Use playback_source to distinguish local and remote.

events.description: Memory audio playback encountered an error. No private audio or raw error message is sent.
events.meaning: Memory audio playback encountered an error.
events.interpretation: No private audio or raw error message is sent.

events.description: Remote memory playback was requested. Request only; does not prove audio actually began.
events.meaning: Remote memory playback was requested.
events.interpretation: Request only; does not prove audio actually began.

events.description: Local memory playback started. Current started instrumentation is local; remote playback has a separate request event.
events.meaning: Local memory playback started.
events.interpretation: Current started instrumentation is local; remote playback has a separate request event.

events.description: The regular capture flow failed at authentication, audio-file validation, or local persistence. Use failure_stage to identify the failing part.
events.meaning: The regular capture flow failed at authentication, audio-file validation, or local persistence.
events.interpretation: Use failure_stage to identify the failing part.

events.description: The system share callback ended without completion or error. Not proof of dissatisfaction.
events.meaning: The system share callback ended without completion or error.
events.interpretation: Not proof of dissatisfaction.

events.description: Share preparation or the system share callback reported an error. Use failure_stage when present.
events.meaning: Share preparation or the system share callback reported an error.
events.interpretation: Use failure_stage when present.

events.description: The prepared memory share sheet was presented. Not a completed share.
events.meaning: The prepared memory share sheet was presented.
events.interpretation: Not a completed share.

events.description: The system share callback reported a completed activity. Not proof of delivery or recipient readership.
events.meaning: The system share callback reported a completed activity.
events.interpretation: Not proof of delivery or recipient readership.

events.meaning: The app could not persist the local state needed to queue a transcription retry.
events.interpretation: failure_stage=local_save; no backend transcription completion is implied.
events.description: The app could not persist the local state needed to queue a transcription retry. failure_stage=local_save; no backend transcription completion is implied.

events.meaning: A requested transcription retry was saved locally with queued status before cloud synchronization was scheduled.
events.interpretation: Not backend acceptance or successful transcription. save_scope=local.
events.description: A requested transcription retry was saved locally with queued status before cloud synchronization was scheduled. Not backend acceptance or successful transcription. save_scope=local.
A named onboarding control was tapped. Use action and screen to distinguish continue, back, skip, reveal, and recording controls.
events.meaning: A named onboarding control was tapped.
events.interpretation: Use action and screen to distinguish continue, back, skip, reveal, and recording controls.

events.description: The person selected who the memoir is for. audience is a bounded choice, never a name.
events.meaning: The person selected who the memoir is for.
events.interpretation: audience is a bounded choice, never a name.

events.description: The onboarding flow moved to the background. Not proof of churn; the person may return.
events.meaning: The onboarding flow moved to the background.
events.interpretation: Not proof of churn; the person may return.

events.description: For analytics_version 2, onboarding exited with a real personalized preview ready and either a rendered subscription offer or an active entitlement. Use onboarding_outcome to separate offer_presented from entitled. Earlier versions completed on paywall-sheet dismissal, even if the offer failed. Neither definition proves a new purchase; compare versions separately.
events.meaning: For analytics_version 2, onboarding exited with a real personalized preview ready and either a rendered subscription offer or an active entitlement.
events.interpretation: Use onboarding_outcome to separate offer_presented from entitled. Earlier versions completed on paywall-sheet dismissal, even if the offer failed. Neither definition proves a new purchase; compare versions separately.

events.description: The person explicitly discarded their local editing draft and deletion succeeded. Does not delete their saved memories.
events.meaning: The person explicitly discarded their local editing draft and deletion succeeded. Does not delete their saved memories.
events.interpretation: Available from native_v7; do not infer historical causes from missing new events.

events.description: A recoverable local editing draft was found and its recovery prompt requested. Does not establish that the person saw or accepted the prompt.
events.meaning: A recoverable local editing draft was found and its recovery prompt requested. Does not establish that the person saw or accepted the prompt.
events.interpretation: Available from native_v7; do not infer historical causes from missing new events.

events.description: The person chose to restore their editing draft. Inputs are restored without starting generation or charging; a missing audio file may still require recovery.
events.meaning: The person chose to restore their editing draft. Inputs are restored without starting generation or charging; a missing audio file may still require recovery.
events.interpretation: Available from native_v7; do not infer historical causes from missing new events.

events.description: The person left onboarding for the app, including recovery exits without a preview or subscription offer. analytics_version 2 separates exiting from successful completion. Use onboarding_outcome: preview_unavailable, offer_unavailable, offer_presented, or entitled. Do not sum Exited and Completed as distinct people.
events.meaning: The person left onboarding for the app, including recovery exits without a preview or subscription offer.
events.interpretation: analytics_version 2 separates exiting from successful completion. Use onboarding_outcome: preview_unavailable, offer_unavailable, offer_presented, or entitled. Do not sum Exited and Completed as distinct people.

events.description: The onboarding flow returned to the foreground. Pair with background events for interruption analysis.
events.meaning: The onboarding flow returned to the foreground.
events.interpretation: Pair with background events for interruption analysis.

events.description: A client attempt to generate the personalized preview began. Use generation_attempt; not authoritative backend admission.
events.meaning: A client attempt to generate the personalized preview began.
events.interpretation: Use generation_attempt; not authoritative backend admission.

events.description: The person explicitly chose the recording or writing control. Permission and consent can still prevent recording; input_method on later events reflects the most recent interaction, not exclusive attribution.
events.meaning: The person explicitly chose the recording or writing control. Permission and consent can still prevent recording; input_method on later events reflects the most recent interaction, not exclusive attribution.
events.interpretation: Available from native_v7; do not infer historical causes from missing new events.

events.description: The capture form changed between empty, too_short, too_long, needs_storyteller, recording, finalizing or ready. Repeated equal states are suppressed; readiness is not a save or generation.
events.meaning: The capture form changed between empty, too_short, too_long, needs_storyteller, recording, finalizing or ready. Repeated equal states are suppressed; readiness is not a save or generation.
events.interpretation: Available from native_v7; do not infer historical causes from missing new events.

events.description: First edit of name or story during this flow. Carries field and flow_id; resumed prefilled text does not count as a fresh edit. No text or name is captured.
events.meaning: First edit of name or story during this flow. Carries field and flow_id; resumed prefilled text does not count as a fresh edit. No text or name is captured.
events.interpretation: Available from native_v7; do not infer historical causes from missing new events.

events.description: The onboarding memory was saved locally before cloud generation. Local persistence does not prove cloud sync or generation success.
events.meaning: The onboarding memory was saved locally before cloud generation.
events.interpretation: Local persistence does not prove cloud sync or generation success.

events.description: The onboarding memory synchronization step completed. Does not mean the generated illustration is ready.
events.meaning: The onboarding memory synchronization step completed.
events.interpretation: Does not mean the generated illustration is ready.

events.description: The onboarding paywall reported a rendered subscription offer. Context event for the onboarding flow. Use Paywall Viewed for the main impression denominator; do not add the two counts. Does not mean purchase or payment.
events.meaning: The onboarding paywall reported a rendered subscription offer.
events.interpretation: Context event for the onboarding flow. Use Paywall Viewed for the main impression denominator; do not add the two counts. Does not mean purchase or payment.

events.description: The onboarding subscription sheet appeared and requested preparation. The offer may still be loading or unavailable. This is not a rendered offer impression; use Paywall Viewed with paywall_source=onboarding.
events.meaning: The onboarding subscription sheet appeared and requested preparation.
events.interpretation: The offer may still be loading or unavailable. This is not a rendered offer impression; use Paywall Viewed with paywall_source=onboarding.

events.description: Legacy event emitted when the onboarding subscription sheet appeared. Retained for historical analysis. analytics_version 2 uses Onboarding Paywall Requested for sheet presentation and Onboarding Offer Ready for a rendered offer. Use Paywall Viewed for the main impression denominator.
events.meaning: Legacy event emitted when the onboarding subscription sheet appeared.
events.interpretation: Retained for historical analysis. analytics_version 2 uses Onboarding Paywall Requested for sheet presentation and Onboarding Offer Ready for a rendered offer. Use Paywall Viewed for the main impression denominator.

events.description: The person navigated to the personalized reveal with image and audio readiness satisfied. Primary activation milestone; not proof the entire page was read or audio heard.
events.meaning: The person navigated to the personalized reveal with image and audio readiness satisfied.
events.interpretation: Primary activation milestone; not proof the entire page was read or audio heard.

events.description: A narrator photo was accepted from the camera or photo library. Only source is tracked; no photo or photo URL is sent.
events.meaning: A narrator photo was accepted from the camera or photo library.
events.interpretation: Only source is tracked; no photo or photo URL is sent.

events.description: Onboarding could not establish the authenticated session required for preparation. Currently failure_stage=auth; not every possible preparation failure is instrumented.
events.meaning: Onboarding could not establish the authenticated session required for preparation.
events.interpretation: Currently failure_stage=auth; not every possible preparation failure is instrumented.

events.description: Account and profile preparation finished. duration_ms measures this attempt; compare with Presented to locate pre-start failures, reconciling identities. Does not prove that a draft-restoration or other error alert was dismissed.
events.meaning: Account and profile preparation finished.
events.interpretation: Available from native_v7; do not infer historical causes from missing new events.

events.description: The onboarding interface appeared before anonymous authentication or session preparation completed. Use as a pre-authentication exposure event. Onboarding Started is emitted later after account preparation; reconcile identities before comparing unique-user counts. This does not prove usable capture controls or a saved story.
events.meaning: The onboarding interface appeared before anonymous authentication or session preparation completed.
events.interpretation: Use as a pre-authentication exposure event. Onboarding Started is emitted later after account preparation; reconcile identities before comparing unique-user counts. This does not prove usable capture controls or a saved story.

events.description: A preview operation was cancelled before a usable result was accepted. Cancellation is separate from a generation failure or successful image. It may follow invalidated inputs, task cancellation, or a server cancellation; it does not prove user abandonment.
events.meaning: A preview operation was cancelled before a usable result was accepted.
events.interpretation: Cancellation is separate from a generation failure or successful image. It may follow invalidated inputs, task cancellation, or a server cancellation; it does not prove user abandonment.

events.description: A client preview attempt ended with a noncancellation error. analytics_version 2 includes allowlisted failure_reason and failure_stage plus client duration_ms. Earlier versions may contain only failure_kind. Repeated attempts are not distinct affected people; no private error message or story is sent.
events.meaning: A client preview attempt ended with a noncancellation error.
events.interpretation: analytics_version 2 includes allowlisted failure_reason and failure_stage plus client duration_ms. Earlier versions may contain only failure_kind. Repeated attempts are not distinct affected people; no private error message or story is sent.

events.description: The client received the personalized preview image result. duration_ms is client elapsed time; separate cached from fresh results.
events.meaning: The client received the personalized preview image result.
events.interpretation: duration_ms is client elapsed time; separate cached from fresh results.

events.description: The person accepted or declined the cloud-transcription disclosure. Use consent_outcome. Accepting this disclosure is not microphone permission, speech-recognition permission, recording success, or story save.
events.meaning: The person accepted or declined the cloud-transcription disclosure.
events.interpretation: Use consent_outcome. Accepting this disclosure is not microphone permission, speech-recognition permission, recording success, or story save.

events.description: The cloud-transcription disclosure was requested after the person chose recording. A disclosure opportunity, not consent or a recording. Pair with Onboarding Recording Consent; do not interpret repeated presentations as distinct people.
events.meaning: The cloud-transcription disclosure was requested after the person chose recording.
events.interpretation: A disclosure opportunity, not consent or a recording. Pair with Onboarding Recording Consent; do not interpret repeated presentations as distinct people.

events.description: The onboarding recorder reported a recording error. Use failure_stage; raw error text is not sent.
events.meaning: The onboarding recorder reported a recording error.
events.interpretation: Use failure_stage; raw error text is not sent.

events.description: The onboarding recorder reported the result of its permission request sequence. Use permission_outcome: microphone_denied, speech_denied, or granted. Granted means both required permissions were authorized, not that recording started, transcription succeeded, or a story was saved. Separate from cloud-transcription disclosure consent.
events.meaning: The onboarding recorder reported the result of its permission request sequence.
events.interpretation: Use permission_outcome: microphone_denied, speech_denied, or granted. Granted means both required permissions were authorized, not that recording started, transcription succeeded, or a story was saved. Separate from cloud-transcription disclosure consent.

events.description: The onboarding recorder changed to recording. Different from tapping the record button; recording_duration is seconds.
events.meaning: The onboarding recorder changed to recording.
events.interpretation: Different from tapping the record button; recording_duration is seconds.

events.description: The onboarding recorder stopped recording. Not confirmation of transcription, saving, or upload.
events.meaning: The onboarding recorder stopped recording.
events.interpretation: Not confirmation of transcription, saving, or upload.

events.description: Alex's sample audio player changed to playing. Demo playback is not the customer's own memory or personalized activation.
events.meaning: Alex's sample audio player changed to playing.
events.interpretation: Demo playback is not the customer's own memory or personalized activation.

events.description: Alex's sample audio player stopped playing. Includes stopping or reaching the end; not a dedicated completion event.
events.meaning: Alex's sample audio player stopped playing.
events.interpretation: Includes stopping or reaching the end; not a dedicated completion event.

events.description: Authenticated onboarding preparation reached its start milestone. May repeat in debug replay; flow_id is view-instance scoped.
events.meaning: Authenticated onboarding preparation reached its start milestone.
events.interpretation: May repeat in debug replay; flow_id is view-instance scoped.

events.description: The flow left a step and measured step_duration_ms. This is a navigation exit, not guaranteed app abandonment tracking.
events.meaning: The flow left a step and measured step_duration_ms.
events.interpretation: This is a navigation exit, not guaranteed app abandonment tracking.

events.description: The onboarding flow displayed a step. Use screen and step; repeated visits are expected.
events.meaning: The onboarding flow displayed a step.
events.interpretation: Use screen and step; repeated visits are expected.

events.description: The person selected whether they or the memoir subject will tell the story. Use storyteller and audience to inspect this choice. It does not establish recording or saved-story completion.
events.meaning: The person selected whether they or the memoir subject will tell the story.
events.interpretation: Use storyteller and audience to inspect this choice. It does not establish recording or saved-story completion.

events.description: The sample-book tour finished and the flow advanced. Does not mean a personalized page was generated or onboarding completed.
events.meaning: The sample-book tour finished and the flow advanced.
events.interpretation: Does not mean a personalized page was generated or onboarding completed.

events.description: A chapter prompt was opened for a recording or prompt-choice flow. Use chapter_number and is_completed; no prompt text is sent.
events.meaning: A chapter prompt was opened for a recording or prompt-choice flow.
events.interpretation: Use chapter_number and is_completed; no prompt text is sent.

events.description: The paywall presentation was dismissed. Use dismissal_reason; closing is not necessarily purchase cancellation.
events.meaning: The paywall presentation was dismissed.
events.interpretation: Use dismissal_reason; closing is not necessarily purchase cancellation.

events.description: Subscription-offer preparation failed or exceeded its allowed duration before a usable offer became available. Use failure_stage and allowlisted failure_kind with paywall_source and presentation_id. This is separate from purchase cancellation, payment failure, or billing problems.
events.meaning: Subscription-offer preparation failed or exceeded its allowed duration before a usable offer became available.
events.interpretation: Use failure_stage and allowlisted failure_kind with paywall_source and presentation_id. This is separate from purchase cancellation, payment failure, or billing problems.

events.description: The paywall preparation operation finished successfully. Use duration_ms, preparation_attempt, and paywall_source for preparation latency. The operation can detect an existing entitlement and dismiss without showing an offer; use Paywall Viewed for rendered impressions. This is not a purchase or payment.
events.meaning: The paywall preparation operation finished successfully.
events.interpretation: Use duration_ms, preparation_attempt, and paywall_source for preparation latency. The operation can detect an existing entitlement and dismiss without showing an offer; use Paywall Viewed for rendered impressions. This is not a purchase or payment.

events.description: The prepared subscription paywall appeared once for a presentation_id. Segment by paywall_source; exposure does not mean purchase intent or payment.
events.meaning: The prepared subscription paywall appeared once for a presentation_id.
events.interpretation: Segment by paywall_source; exposure does not mean purchase intent or payment.

events.meaning: Regular memory recording could not start because authentication was unavailable, recorder creation failed, or the recorder refused to begin.
events.interpretation: Use bounded diagnostic_reason. This does not include every permission refusal or recording failure; no raw error message or file path is sent.
events.description: Regular memory recording could not start because authentication was unavailable, recorder creation failed, or the recorder refused to begin. Use bounded diagnostic_reason. This does not include every permission refusal or recording failure; no raw error message or file path is sent.
The regular recording flow successfully saved a memory locally. save_scope=local; not a cloud-sync guarantee or all capture routes.
events.meaning: The regular recording flow successfully saved a memory locally.
events.interpretation: save_scope=local; not a cloud-sync guarantee or all capture routes.

events.meaning: A foreground-active timing segment ended for the topmost instrumented screen.
events.interpretation: duration_ms excludes inactive/background time and covered instrumented screens. Sum segments for dwell; event count is not visits. A crash or force quit can lose the final segment. System pickers and other uninstrumented overlays can still count toward the parent.
events.description: A foreground-active timing segment ended for the topmost instrumented screen. duration_ms excludes inactive/background time and covered instrumented screens. Sum segments for dwell; event count is not visits. A crash or force quit can lose the final segment. System pickers and other uninstrumented overlays can still count toward the parent.

An instrumented screen view instance appeared, or its bounded screen name changed. Revisits can repeat; inactive-to-active resume does not create another view event. Underlying screens resumed after a sheet do not create a new view. Appearance is not proof of reading.
events.meaning: An instrumented screen view instance appeared, or its bounded screen name changed.
events.interpretation: Revisits can repeat; inactive-to-active resume does not create another view event. Underlying screens resumed after a sheet do not create a new view. Appearance is not proof of reading.

events.description: The active session ended; duration_ms measures foreground session time. Process termination may prevent delivery; not total lifetime usage.
events.meaning: The active session ended; duration_ms measures foreground session time.
events.interpretation: Process termination may prevent delivery; not total lifetime usage.

events.description: The app entered an active foreground session. Repeated active notifications are deduplicated until the session ends.
events.meaning: The app entered an active foreground session.
events.interpretation: Repeated active notifications are deduplicated until the session ends.

events.description: The current account was signed out before analytics identity was reset. A subsequent guest identity is a separate state.
events.meaning: The current account was signed out before analytics identity was reset.
events.interpretation: A subsequent guest identity is a separate state.

events.description: The regular memory recorder successfully began audio capture. Separate from onboarding recording; no audio is sent to analytics.
events.meaning: The regular memory recorder successfully began audio capture.
events.interpretation: Separate from onboarding recording; no audio is sent to analytics.

events.description: The app could not activate or verify the expected entitlement. Not necessarily a failed App Store charge; inspect purchase_origin and failure_stage.
events.meaning: The app could not activate or verify the expected entitlement.
events.interpretation: Not necessarily a failed App Store charge; inspect purchase_origin and failure_stage.

events.description: The app began applying or verifying an entitlement after purchase or restore. Use purchase_origin to separate purchase and restore.
events.meaning: The app began applying or verifying an entitlement after purchase or restore.
events.interpretation: Use purchase_origin to separate purchase and restore.

events.description: The app confirmed a usable subscription entitlement. Can include a trial or restored entitlement; use RevenueCat lifecycle events for paid revenue.
events.meaning: The app confirmed a usable subscription entitlement.
events.interpretation: Can include a trial or restored entitlement; use RevenueCat lifecycle events for paid revenue.

events.description: The person explicitly selected the yearly or monthly plan card. Use subscription_plan; this is not a purchase or trial start.
events.meaning: The person explicitly selected a subscription plan card.
events.interpretation: Use subscription_plan; this is not a purchase or trial start.

events.description: The purchase flow reported user cancellation. Not a refund or subscription expiration.
events.meaning: The purchase flow reported user cancellation.
events.interpretation: Not a refund or subscription expiration.

events.description: The purchase flow reported an error. Not a confirmed charge; use failure_stage.
events.meaning: The purchase flow reported an error.
events.interpretation: Not a confirmed charge; use failure_stage.

events.description: The paywall purchase flow started. Not a confirmed charge or entitlement.
events.meaning: The paywall purchase flow started.
events.interpretation: Not a confirmed charge or entitlement.

events.description: The restore flow reported an error. Does not prove the customer has no existing entitlement.
events.meaning: The restore flow reported an error.
events.interpretation: Does not prove the customer has no existing entitlement.

events.description: The person started restoring purchases. Not a new purchase.
events.meaning: The person started restoring purchases.
events.interpretation: Not a new purchase.

events.description: The selected home or saved-memories tab changed. Not every tab appearance or initial app landing.
events.meaning: The selected home or saved-memories tab changed.
events.interpretation: Not every tab appearance or initial app landing.

events.description: An audited named control action was explicitly reported. Use action and screen; does not capture every tap automatically.
events.meaning: An audited named control action was explicitly reported.
events.interpretation: Use action and screen; does not capture every tap automatically.

events.description: A saved memory detail view appeared. Can repeat on revisits; not proof the memory was fully read.
events.meaning: A saved memory detail view appeared.
events.interpretation: Can repeat on revisits; not proof the memory was fully read.
